_comment: NPC: Wang Ping (王平). Canon ID: N07. CRON-COMPLETIONIST-116: registered as a canon NPC at the Suzaku Tomb (朱雀墓) — his conception site. Canon (web-search verified 2026-07-27, Baidu Baike https://baike.baidu.com/item/王平/62563845 + Fandom wiki https://xian-ni.fandom.com/wiki/Wang_Ping + newhanfu + Toutiao + 163): Wang Ping is Wang Lin's BIOLOGICAL son by 木冰眉 / 柳眉 (Mu Bingmei's 9th avatar Liu Mei), conceived in the Suzaku Tomb from an accidental union. Refined into a 怨婴 (resentment infant) by Liu Mei for ~100 years. Later rebuilt by Wang Lin from sword qi (剑气) — a 'false life' that cannot cry, is sterile, has NO cultivation talent, cannot sense spiritual qi. Lived a mortal life (~72 years) with Wang Lin during the 二次化凡 (second mortal transformation) / 梦道 (Dream Dao) arc; became a mortal emperor (帝王); married 青宜 (Qing Yi). At ~72, voluntarily dispersed his sword-qi body; 残魂 (remnant soul) sealed into the 天逆珠 by Wang Lin. First appears Vol 7 Ch 680 《柳眉的特殊法宝》 as '厉儿 (Li'er)'; named 王平 in Vol 7 Ch 681. At story start, Wang Ping is canonically a 怨婴 (resentment infant) — flagged deadUntilRevived=true so CanonActorMaterializer refuses to spawn him on chunk load. A future Wang Ping redemption event (parallel to Li Muwan's CRON-100/102 revival arc) would clear the flag. Prime Directive: Reality is objective; cultivation changes understanding, not existence. Every being described here exists independently of the player's perception.
name: Wang Ping
cultivation: Mortal (凡人) — cannot cultivate; sword-qi body has no spiritual qi sensitivity
personality: silent, observant, melancholic; cannot cry (sword-qi body limitation); sterile; carries the wound of his mother's betrayal without expression
speech: rare, soft, measured; speaks only when necessary; cannot raise his voice
relationship_to_wanglin: biological son; Wang Lin rebuilt him from sword qi after Liu Mei refined him into a 怨婴; lived ~72 years as a mortal with Wang Lin during the 二次化凡 arc; unconditional paternal bond

perception_tiers.mortal: A quiet boy who never cries
perception_tiers.qi_condensation: A boy with strange Qi — like sword qi, not cultivation Qi
perception_tiers.core_formation: A sword-qi construct; not truly alive in the cultivation sense
perception_tiers.nascent_soul: Wang Lin's biological son, rebuilt from sword qi after Liu Mei's 怨婴 refinement
perception_tiers.spirit_severing: The sword-qi vessel of Wang Ping; his 残魂 is destined for the 天逆珠

note: Wang Lin's biological son by Mu Bingmei / Liu Mei (her 9th avatar), conceived in the Suzaku Tomb. Refined into a 怨婴 by Liu Mei; rebuilt from sword qi by Wang Lin; lived a mortal life (~72 years) during the 二次化凡 arc. At ~72, voluntarily dispersed his sword-qi body; 残魂 sealed into the 天逆珠. First appears Vol 7 Ch 680 as '厉儿 (Li'er)'; named 王平 in Vol 7 Ch 681. Canon sources: Baidu Baike (https://baike.baidu.com/item/王平/62563845), Fandom wiki (https://xian-ni.fandom.com/wiki/Wang_Ping), newhanfu, Toutiao, 163. NO fabricated chapter citations beyond Ch 680/681 (Baidu Baike-attested).

dao_heart.note: 0-100. A cracked Dao heart blocks breakthrough regardless of Qi. Wang Ping's Dao heart is paradoxically stable — he has no cultivation ambition to crack it. His wound is existential, not Dao-related.

canon_notes.biological_son: Wang Ping is Wang Lin's BIOLOGICAL son by 木冰眉 / 柳眉 (Mu Bingmei's 9th avatar Liu Mei), conceived in the 朱雀墓 (Suzaku Tomb) from an accidental union. NOT adopted — the animation/donghua 'blood-soul' framing is 魔改 (non-canon for the novel).
canon_notes.refinement_into_resentful_infant: Liu Mei refined Wang Ping into a 怨婴 (resentment infant) for ~100 years, leaving only a wisp of resentful soul. This is effectively his death as a normal child.
canon_notes.sword_qi_reconstruction: Wang Lin saved Wang Ping's remnant soul and rebuilt a body from sword qi (剑气) — a 'false life'. The sword-qi body cannot cry, is sterile, has NO cultivation talent, cannot sense spiritual qi.
canon_notes.mortal_life_with_wang_lin: Lived a mortal life (~72 years) with Wang Lin during the 二次化凡 (second mortal transformation) / 梦道 (Dream Dao) arc. Became a mortal emperor (帝王), married 青宜 (Qing Yi).
canon_notes.final_fate: At ~72, Wang Ping voluntarily dispersed his sword-qi body; his 残魂 (remnant soul) was sealed into the 天逆珠 (Heaven-Defying Bead) by Wang Lin. 青宜 followed him in death; her soul was also collected to accompany him.
canon_notes.chapter_citations: First appears Vol 7 Ch 680 《柳眉的特殊法宝》 as '厉儿 (Li'er)'. Named 王平 in Vol 7 Ch 681. Both citations are Baidu Baike-attested (https://baike.baidu.com/item/王平/62563845).
canon_notes.sources: Baidu Baike (https://baike.baidu.com/item/王平/62563845); Fandom wiki (https://xian-ni.fandom.com/wiki/Wang_Ping); newhanfu (https://www.newhanfu.com/81534.html); Toutiao (https://www.toutiao.com/article/7638935916031066670); 163. NO fabricated chapter citations.

initiation_lines: ... (Wang Ping does not speak. He watches you with eyes that cannot cry.)
Father says you are a cultivator. I cannot sense your Qi. I am sorry.
I am Wang Ping. I was born of the Suzaku Tomb. My mother refined me; my father rebuilt me. I am a sword-qi construct — a false life.
Do not ask me to cry. The sword qi that is my body has no tears to give.
When I disperse, my 残魂 will go into the 天逆珠. Father has promised me this. 青宜 will follow.

daily_schedule.action: Sit silently at the Suzaku Tomb entrance, watching the dawn
Walk the perimeter of the Suzaku Tomb — the site of his conception
Sit with Father (Wang Lin) in silent companionship
Walk to a high point and watch the horizon — longing for 青宜
Sit under the stars — sword-qi body faintly visible in moonlight
Rest (does not truly sleep — sword-qi body enters stasis)
